To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) the settling behavior of red mud can improve by converting goethites into hematites and/or magnetites, and 2) the by-product Bayer sodalite has the high exchange capacity to Na+.
the settling of red mud is improved by converting goetheite into hematite or magnetite, which produces a red mud with larger particle size, larger specific gravity, and smaller specific surface area.

the iron mineral transformation in the Bayer process can be utilized to produce red muds with a higher solid concentration, which reduces the total volume of the red mud slurry to dispose of and which allows for less potential contamination of the environment by caustic soda.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of iron transformation in Bayer process on red mud settling behavior, and physical, chemical and mineralogical characteristics of red mud.
developing the understanding of the mineralogical and chemical properties of red mud and with developing a process for the reduction of red mud volume.
the reduction of red mud volume and caustic soda loss by optimizing the Bayer process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
iron mineral transformation is an important factor in determining the properties of red mud and that it can have an impact on the settling behavior of red mud slurry.
the Bayer process should be modified to increase the amount of goethite converted to hematite and/or magentite to improve settling and reduce the environmental impact of red mud.
the iron mineral transformations are the key to the red mud properties, and that the red mud settling behavior is a key to the red slurry volume.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the iron mineral transformations can be used as an effective tool to reduce red mud volume.

the red mud with the largest particle size, smallest specific surface area, largest specific gravity, and lowest Bayer sodalite content is most desirable for settling behavior and environmental safety.
the Bayer process is an important technology in the production of aluminum, and the red muds produced are a major environmental concern.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Bayer process operating conditions can be adjusted to produce a more easily disposed-of red mud.
the settling rate of red muds can be enhanced by converting goethites to hematite and/or magentite.

red muds derived at different operating conditions have different settling behavior and physical properties, and that the settling behavior and physical and chemical properties can be modified through iron mineral transformations.
